reviews.title: Intro
reviews.text: I feel the start up would need more visual examples for people with adhd and why you might select this choice. When you get to select what you want to learn so from the beginning it starts making a schedule for us

reviews.title: Good app, Math Latex Rendering needs to be fixed
reviews.text: Amazing app, will definitely spend money on it if the bugs get fixed. Big critique is the LATEX Math rendering keeps bugging out. Especially visible in Universal and Existential Quantifiers lesson in Math. This is a common thing I’ve seen in my experience with Claude which I assume the app uses.

reviews.text: i’ve been wanting to make a personal curriculum and this was literally what i was looking for

reviews.title: Love this
reviews.text: Love this, very interactive and fun

reviews.title: Great app in its early stages
reviews.text: Great app for organized learning for whatever topic you want. Really cool idea, kind of like Duolingo for anything. Been using it for a few weeks now and already a lot of the initial problems have been fixed. Highly recommend it for anyone that’s curious in life long learning or wanting to build new skills!

reviews.title: Very helpful!
reviews.text: This app is currently helping me with my state test and i hope i will pass!

reviews.title: Definitely bugs, but great Overall
reviews.text:
I know this app is new so bugs are to be expected. Currently having issues with accessing the last lesson in a chapter due to it cutting off at the bottom of the screen. Also, I’m having to close and reopen the app every time I finish a lesson, otherwise if I try to start the next lesson, it will just say lesson complete.

Overall, this is a great concept and I’m really enjoying it. Definitely going to help review for some of my college classes.

reviews.title: Solid app
reviews.text: This is easy for me to learn and try and stay consistent while learning valuable material

reviews.title: Sooo glitchy
reviews.text: Decided to test this app out because the concept sounded interesting. But in just my first section there were glitches where I’d click one word and another would pop up. If you try swapping tracks when you’ve already started it’s a whole mess. Also just thought they’d teach the topics in funner way…

reviews.title: First lesson bug
reviews.text: A major flaw is when you try to answer a question with the same answer the first input invalidates the placement for the second input, leaving only a single answer and no continuation of the lesson due to the fact that I can’t put the same answer twice either a code needs to be implemented where options don’t disappear and it’s a nice and cool thing functionality wise. It’s terrible.

reviews.title: Incredible Micro-Learning
reviews.text: Really fun way to get a little better every day. Highly recommend.
